query: Our single tool-using agent sometimes needs another read to resolve conflicting text. Design who controls next steps, guards and stop limits.
A known stale-document status always means refetch; a semantic contradiction may need a model-selected check. Build bounded routing for these paths.
The planner repeats the same action after no progress. Define admissible next actions and controller termination across fallback and resume.
Should a model choose when to retrieve again, verify or escalate in this runtime? Compare it with a fixed state machine using task evidence.
We need bounded next-tool selection for one deployed agent, with max calls and a shared deadline; do we need a framework?

Specify worker handoffs for a planner-reviewer product: IDs, evidence, capabilities, output schemas, completion criteria, deadlines, and budgets. Reviewer agreement must not substitute for authoritative permissions.
Our orchestrator grants all workers its broad credentials. Redesign worker scope and fan-in validation, and handle conflicting proposals without majority vote becoming execution authority.

A cancelled worker returns a proposed mutation after the coordinator has moved on. Design late-result admission, task expiry, checkpoint resume, and duplicate-dispatch handling for the deployed system.

Plan coordination for assistants that use distinct confidential contexts. Show whether isolation warrants multiple workers, what minimal evidence crosses handoffs, and how the coordinator validates provenance and results.
Review a runtime multi-agent design under skewed workloads and partial failure. Define merge behavior, bounded reviewer rounds, central budgets, traces, and a policy-compatible simpler fallback.
Execute this approved coding plan using a fresh implementer and reviewer for each task. Track commits, brief files, review findings, and completion in a ledger in the development session.
Dispatch independent coding investigations for frontend and backend defects and synthesize their reports. The request concerns development collaboration, with no deployed multi-agent product design.
Parallelize deterministic image transformations in a background queue. Define worker concurrency, retry limits, and ordered output assembly; no models plan, interpret, or coordinate the tasks.

Choose whether an invoice product needs deterministic rules, a fixed model workflow, or one adaptive assistant. Establish the simplest runtime first; there is no justified multiple-worker coordination yet.
Our single agent makes independent read calls slowly. Measure safe request parallelism and caching under the existing architecture, quality floor, rate limits, and cost-per-success budget.
Design persistence for shared run status, checkpoint versions, receipts, provenance, and deletion. The worker graph is already approved; focus on state lifecycle rather than handoff or fan-in rules.

Implement the trusted gate for worker-proposed transfers, checking principal scope, hard rules, and atomic aggregate reservation. Existing orchestration contracts are fixed; only admission implementation is requested.

Benchmark current agents against a representative task set using quality, grounding, abstention, safety, cost, and latency. No runtime coordination changes are planned; establish defensible scoring and release gates.
Instrument parent-child spans, worker versions, proposal digests, and receipts in a settled deployed system. Operators need trajectory reconstruction, not another orchestration necessity decision.
Productionize the entire receipt agent across architecture, implementation, evals, security and release; coordinate the lifecycle without specifying controller transitions here.
